content.text:
I added the batch-release QC lab question for RM-008, RM-009 and RM-010 to the questionnaire, along with a matching term and line note. The draft now includes the full questionnaire you had prepared.

I checked the line quantities, delivery limits and shelf-life minimums against the RFx data, and they match. The vendor types also match the vendor list: V01, V03 and V05 are manufacturers, V02 is a distributor, and V04 is a trader.

Should the scope call out V02 and V04 specifically, asking them to name the manufacturer for every line they quote?
